attribution.title: Amsterdam Sloterdijk Station
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free reconstruction (rebuilt 2026-11-10): both glazed vaults over the north-south viaducts with blue ribs, grey belly, red band and lettering; the glass hall under the white space-frame table on lattice towers with tree feet; the glazed wedge concourse; the Regenboogpad with its two round lift towers; short low-level platform canopies. Plan from the PDOK 2023 orthophoto, heights from 3DBAG, look from Wikimedia Commons and Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas. Orlyplein, the bus station and the adjacent hotel not suppressed.
